revision4Finding.ARCH-DEL-04: Recovery errors are versioned by owner and generation. Successful completion clears only the recovery-owned error if its exact version is still current. Other action starts, clears and errors advance the shared error version and invalidate the recovery marker, so late recovery completion cannot clear a newer unrelated error.
